title: I asked AI for the seahorse emoji 🐴

beats.say: I asked AI to show me the seahorse emoji.
Sure! Here it is. Tropical fish. Wait. No.
Horse! No, unicorn! Ocean wave? Okay, final answer. Horse.
Here's the twist. There are zero seahorse emojis. There never were.
One was proposed in 2018, and it got rejected.

beats.sub: a Mandela effect for humans and bots
beats.say: But tons of people swear they remember it. And AI learned from those people.

beats.sub: one theory: it grabs the closest emoji, sees it's wrong, retries
beats.say: One theory: the AI lands on seahorse, finds no emoji for it, grabs the closest one, sees it's wrong, and spirals.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
